findings.claim: L73 supersedes the 'no independent verification' wording of L71 (e) and L72 (e) only through a note in a later entry. Both earlier entries stay unedited, so a reader of L72 Open (e) alone still sees 'Batch 10 has had no independent verification' as a gap. The correction is easy to miss because L73 is the only place that points back to those entries. A short pointer ('superseded by L73') in L71 and L72 would remove the ambiguity, though the append-only Log convention may make this deliberate.

evidence: The diff changes only the T6 task line and appends the L73 Log entry in one markdown file. No code is touched.
The T6 line is consistent with L73 on the batch 11 hash `e97bdfc7`, the L72 hash `a050d4a0`, and the last verification at `6c59570b` (DE1-DE7).
The T6 line and L73 agree that batches 9-11 are Risk none with no independent verifier by rule. I found no factual contradiction between them.
